name: ask_user.lua
description: Ask the user one or more questions with selectable options or custom answers. Use the 'questions' array to ask several questions back-to-back in a single call, or use top-level 'question' + 'options' for a single question.

name: cron.lua
description: Manage Bone scheduled jobs for the user (daily HH:MM schedules). Use this when the user asks to schedule, list, remove, or inspect recurring Bone tasks. Actions: add (requires name, time, prompt), list, remove (requires name), logs (requires name, optional tail). Examples: cron(action=list); cron(action=add, name=daily-clean, time=09:00, approval=danger, prompt=/clean src/main.rs); cron(action=remove, name=daily-clean); cron(action=logs, name=daily-clean, tail=100).

name: subagent.lua
description: Manage named sub-agents and delegate tasks to them.

name: task_list.lua
description: Maintain a visible checklist (TUI pane) for the user. Use it for any task with ~3+ distinct steps or work spanning multiple files. Call 'write' with the FULL list every time — it replaces the whole list, so there are no indices to track. Keep at most one item 'in_progress' (the step you're working on now); flip it to 'done' when finished. Once the work is genuinely complete, call 'complete' to mark the whole current list done. Call 'clear' only when the user confirms. State is host-held; no state arg. Actions: write (pass tasks, optional name, max 15), complete, clear.

name: web_search.lua
description: Search the web for information using DuckDuckGo. Returns titles, URLs and summaries. Useful for looking up documentation, current events, technical topics, and general knowledge.

name: goal.lua
description: Start, resume, check, or stop an autonomous goal.

name: memory.lua
description: Manage global and current-project memory; both are injected into every turn.

name: recap.lua
description: Show a brief recap of the conversation

name: review.lua
description: Review uncommitted changes for real bugs (verification-first; /review [low|medium|high])

name: shotgun.lua
description: Fan a prompt out to configured providers; the chat agent synthesizes the answers

name: themes.lua
description: Pick or apply an installed color theme

name: usage.lua
description: Show token usage for current conversation
